item.title: The Sonoma County Fair — Fri Aug 7, 10:00 AM — Sonoma County Fairgrounds
item.description:
A celebration of community spirit, agriculture, entertainment, and wholesome fun.
The Sonoma County Fair is an annual event that captivates visitors with its vibrant atmosphere and diverse offerings. Held in scenic Sonoma County, California, this fair is a celebration of community spirit, agriculture, entertainment, and wholesome fun. From thrilling amusement rides and live music performances to engaging exhibits showcasing local produce, crafts, and artwork, the fair offers something for everyone. Attendees can indulge in mouthwatering fair food, participate in thrilling competitions, enjoy live animal exhibits, and explore the region’s rich agricultural heritage. With its charming blend of entertainment and education, the Sonoma County Fair is a must-visit destination that brings joy and excitement to people of all ages.
Source: GoLocal Cooperative

item.title: H&L Live: Burrows & Dilbeck — Sat Aug 8, 1:00 PM — Hook & Ladder Winery
item.description:
**H&L Live: Burrows & Dilbeck**
Get ready for an evening of soul, funk, and masterful songwriting as Burrows & Dilbeck take the stage for H&L Live.
Spencer Burrows and Kris Dilbeck are the powerhouse duo behind North Bay's legendary super-funk-rock band Frobeck, which earned two North Bay Music Awards over their 13-year run. These Sonoma State University and Berklee College of Music alumni have opened for internationally known acts including WAR, Los Lonely Boys, Ivan Neville's Dumpstaphunk, Bootsy Collins, and the Sons of Champlin.
With seven full-length albums under their belt, Burrows and Dilbeck have harnessed their soul, funk, and pop-rock influences into a unique sound that's earned praise from music legends. Bill Champlin of Chicago calls Spencer "one of the best singers I've ever heard... ever," while Emilio Castillo of Tower of Power praises their "powerful vocals" and "real strong songwriting."

item.title: OAEC Garden Tour — Sat Aug 15, 1:00 PM — Occidental Arts and Ecology Center
item.description: Join us for a guided tour of the Occidental Arts & Ecology Center’s demonstration gardens and living landscapes. Led by rotating OAEC staff, these tours offer an opportunity to explore our diverse food, medicinal, pollinator, and native plant gardens while learning about the ecological principles that guide our work. When: Tours start at 1pm every first and third Saturday of the month, April through October. Where: Tours start and end at the OAEC Nursery. 15290 Coleman Valley Rd, Occidental, CA 95465. Upper Driveway. Important Information: No registration required—just show up! Please use the second driveway and park in the upper lot near the greenhouses. The tour route includes steep hills and unpaved dirt and gravel paths. Sturdy shoes, a brimmed hat, and weather-appropriate layers are recommended. Shop with purpose at Kendra Scott’s Montgomery Village location during their Give Back Event benefiting Magical Bridge Foundation. Stop by the store on Saturday, August 15th from 4:00 to 6:00 p.m. for an in-person shopping event, or shop online August 15th and 16th using code GIVEBACK-MGEOE at checkout. Either way, 20% of your purchase goes directly to an incredible cause.
Magical Bridge Foundation creates multigenerational playgrounds, parks, and programs to foster more inclusive communities, removing the physical and social barriers of typical playgrounds so people of every age and ability can experience the joy of play and connection. It is a cause rooted in belonging, and a reminder that the simplest pleasures should be accessible to everyone. Magical Bridge
Kendra Scott is located at 2416 Sonoma Avenue, next to Anthropologie. Can’t make it in person? Shop online at kendrascott.com August 15 and 16 with code GIVEBACK-MGEOE and your purchase still counts.
Source: North Bay Bohemi

item.title: Soul Motion®: Body Prayer every Sunday in person — Sun Aug 16, 10:00 AM — Wischemann Hall
item.description: BODY PRAYER IS A FACILITATED EVENT DEVOTED TO INQUIRY INTO EMBODIED CONSCIOUSNESS THROUGH MOVEMENT. This class is offered every Sunday morning, and led by Zuza Engler or another teacher. It is usually attended by a vibrant & diverse bunch of welcoming and friendly people, some of whom have practiced Soul Motion® for years, while some ~ never before. What to expect Guidance and structure are part of every week’s class as we travel across the four landscapes of Soul Motion®: Dance Infinite (prayer space) Dance Community (ensemble) Dance Communion (duet) Dance Intimate (solo) Practices, structures, and points of view are offered to facilitate the journey. Participants are invited to travel across all landscapes, not just their favorite one: dancing by oneself, in duet, in ensemble with several people and eventually the whole room, or witnessing in stillness the beauty of another’s or of everyone’s dance. item.title: Amina Figarova - at THE 222 for a 2nd Night / with Edition 113 — Sun Aug 16, 7:00 PM — THE 222
item.description:
Pianist and composer **Amina Figarova** leads her ensemble **Edition 113** in an acoustic performance that highlights the group’s interplay, clarity of sound, and expressive range within a chamber jazz setting. The new recording seems to celebrate New York with a mix of modern jazz, funk – and Figarova’s distinctive, thoughtful writing. Other band members include Rez Abbasi on guitar, Amina Scott on bass and Ferenc Nemeth on drums.
Aptly titled, *Persistence* is a surprising delight and one that seemingly avoids many of the pitfalls of fusion. The opening title track launches into enthralling rhythmic interplay between drums and bass, while flutist Bart Platteau channels the spirit of the Headhunters in his soaring melodies. Figarova, meanwhile, artfully comps, switching between piano and synthesizer.
